test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. P sits to the immediate left of Q. P sits second to the right of L. Z sits at one of the extreme ends of the row. Only one person sits to the right of S. K sits to the immediate right of D. L sits second to the right of D. Only two people sit between D and Z. Only one person sits between Q and S. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
**Given:**

A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north.

Solution:

(1) Z sits at one of the extreme ends of the row.

(2) Only one person sits to the right of S.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f5f31cd135e6097003b54e741b5a52da46eb2e3ac9fc3d5ebfc94dbf06a773c.png] 

 

(3) Only one person sits between Q and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2604e229f38d05e095ed4e707dea43dbda49e8b79e4d62853ebde0654ed5c82b.png] 

(4) Only two people sit between D and Z. This is possible only in Case 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac49ea20ba19e95297803e7223e906be462b9512dde517690fdc564fe116300b.png] 

(5) P sits to the immediate left of Q. 

(6) P sits second to the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83f54a07f048e442e8b002d201fa6fd5d37ef4506ca4cc3592cb4c785bbf6881.png] 

(7) K sits to the immediate right of D. 

(8) L sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37115b1e6428d11c6b6f2d47c1180d005610989958f142222fb9c0719705a704.png] 

So here, 12 is the total number of persons seated.

**Hence, '12' is the correct answer.**
